title: X11: `DisplayServer.window_set_size` does not update viewport
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4], v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.5.dev2.official [af2c713]

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev2

### Issue description

I encountered an issue where, when using DisplayServer.window_set_size(...), the window expands or shrinks, but the render does not follow it, although the render itself continues working normally. I think it just doesn't resize according to the new window dimensions. That is, the window size changes, but the render does not. The render size update happens when moving the window, but this does not occur through methods in GDScript. I also tried to emulate different things, but so far I haven't found a way to refresh the render. I also checked this in the release, and it behaves the same, but this issue does not occur on Windows.

Additionally, I would note that in the video, you can see the same issue #105419, where the window appears in one of the corners of the screen and then only gets centered.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
var newSize: Vector2i = <size>
DisplayServer.window_set_size(newSize)
DisplayServer.window_set_position(
	(DisplayServer.screen_get_size(DisplayServer.window_get_current_screen()) -newSize) / 2)
```
